scenarios.description: Continue normal operation at the current production rate for the full horizon.
scenarios.failure_probability_source: GRU model, current real input window (unmodified)

scenarios.description: Stop now for preventive maintenance (4.5h, the fleet's empirical average planned-maintenance duration), then resume normal operation.
scenarios.failure_probability_source: GRU model, counterfactual post-maintenance input (fleet-wide healthy-state training averages + reset maintenance fields)

scenarios.description: Reduce production rate/load by 20% for the full horizon.
scenarios.failure_probability_source: GRU model, counterfactual input with load/torque/rpm/production_rate scaled down 20% from the machine's real current readings

recommendation_basis: highest estimated_net_value_usd across the 3 simulated scenarios
